rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing
Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, and wide spacing
Use varied weights to break standard Regular/Bold binary

layout.generous_spacing: Use p-8 or p-12 for container padding instead of p-4

dashboard.name: The Control Room Grid
rules: h-full on children for vertical alignment
Primary Data: col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3

marketing.name: The Tetris Grid
rules: Never fill 100% perfectly, leave negative space

surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift and shadow-sm.
surfaces.headers: Solid background with hard bottom border or Crystal Glass (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/40).
surfaces.modals: Flat solid background, dark overlay (bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-sm).

components.button: Solid colors, crisp edges. Avoid excessive border-radius. Use hover:bg-primary/90.
components.input: Subtle borders, bg-transparent or bg-white. Focus ring must be distinct (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2).
components.card: Use div with border-border instead of Shadcn Card for more layout freedom where needed. Inside Dashboard, use pure flat cards.
components.tables: Sortable headers, left-aligned data, right-aligned numbers. Use Shadcn Table.
components.charts: Recharts with earthy color palette (Forest Green, Sage, Ochre, Terracotta). Accessible tooltips.
components.navigation: Sidebar for Dashboard (collapsible on mobile). Top header for marketing/onboarding.

logo.description: Clean minimal geometric logo design for ConnectClub in deep forest green and warm sand

tax_hero.description: Abstract financial calculator or papers, warm tones

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have visible hover states. Buttons: bg shift. Cards: slight translate-y.
motion.loading: Use skeletal loaders for dashboard widgets instead of spinners.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy). The primary color is deep forest green (#1A362D).
DO NOT use Inter or standard fonts for headings. Use Outfit for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Dashboard should follow 'Control Room' grid protocol. Dense, flat cards with 1px border. No heavy drop shadows.
Implement the 5-step onboarding with a clean, centered layout and progress indicators.
For the Tax Center, use clear, high-contrast typography for numbers and Recharts for quarterly visualisations.
Use placeholder commission values like '$50 at close, $10/month residual' inside the Commission Tracker.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for testing (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Add 'lucide-react' for icons and use 'recharts' for data viz.
Ensure the ConnectClub logo is prominently placed in the sidebar and auth screens.
Provide a smooth responsive experience: Sidebar hidden behind hamburger on mobile, visible on desktop.
